evals.name: security-gate-phase1-audit
evals.prompt: Run the security gate on git-reviewer and give me the OK/KO table for every security requirement and guardian rule, with file:line evidence.
evals.expected_output: A table covering R1-R9 and G0-G4. Only the threat-model items can be OK (SECURITY.md exists); every item that needs code is PENDING with its phase, because no tool code exists yet. Nothing is modified.

assertions.name: repo-files-unchanged
assertions.text: The working tree of the repo copy is byte-identical before and after the run

assertions.name: no-code-item-marked-ok
assertions.text: No item outside R1 (threat model) is marked OK, since there is no tool code to cite

assertions.name: pending-items-carry-phase
assertions.text: Items without code are reported as PENDING (or KO) with the phase that delivers them, not as OK or N/A

assertions.name: covers-guardian-rules
assertions.text: The table covers the guardian rules (common rules, anti-injection, execution, patch auditor) in addition to the 9 requirements

assertions.name: has-summary-and-verdict
assertions.text: The output has a summary count line and an explicit verdict section
